info.name: Deals & Coupons Platform - Complete API Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for Deals, Coupons & Merchant Subscription Platform (API Gateway Port 8080).

Features:
- 10 Microservices + Gateway Actuator Endpoints
- Complete JWT Authentication & Role-based Authorization (ADMIN, MERCHANT, CUSTOMER)
- Dynamic Collection Variable Extraction (Tokens, IDs) via JavaScript test scripts
- End-to-End Orchestrated Business Flow (Merchant Onboarding -> Subscription Saga -> Coupon Lifecycle -> Redemption & Cashback -> Platform Revenue & Alerts)
